t: Din ezeh meqomot niqraim muqqapim ledira
s: Din ezeh meqomot niqraim muqqapim ledira ubo k"b seipim: kol heqqep mechitztzot shello huqqap ledirat adam liknisa vitzia tamid, kegon rechaba sheachore habbattim vehaqqarpep — vehu heqqep gadol lehaknis bo etzim laotzar — vehagginna vehappardes hammuqqapim gader gaboah y' tepachim vekol kayyotze bahen mehammeqomot sheyyitbaer besimman shs"b, aseru chakamim letaltel betokan yoter mid' ammot kemo birshut harabbim. Veap al pi shehen reshut hayyachid gemura min hattora, vehazzoreq letokan mereshut harabbim chayyab, shehare mechitztzot gemurot hen, ella shemmechussarin diyyurin — hare hen kekarmelit middibre soperim, shekkevan sheenan asuyin ledira, mitchallepin hen birshut harabbim im hen heqqep gadol. Abal heqqep qatan eno mitchallep birshut harabbim, umuttar letaltel betoko ap al pi shello huqqap ledira:

Vekamma hu heqqep qatan? Ad bet satayim vead biklal, kachatzar hammishkan shehaya mea orek ven' rochab, shehen b' peamim n' al n', ven' al n' hu bet sea, shehu b' alapim vet"q peamim amma al amma, vesatayim hen Hashem alapim amma al amma. Vekol maqom sheyyesh bo keshiur zeh, ben shehu agol ben shehu merubba mammash, kegon sheorko a' amma ub' shelishe amma veod mashshehu — velo chashu chakamim ledaqdeq bo — veken rochbo, ben shehu arok veqatzar kegon sheorko mea verochbo chamishshim — muttar letaltel bekullo, ubilbad shello yehe orko yater al pi shenayim berochbo amma achat, kemo shechatzar hammishkan lo haya orko yater al pi shenayim berochbo apillu amma achat. Abal pachot meamma eno kelum veeno oser:

Vesameku chakamim shiurim ellu leshiure chatzar hammishkan, lepi shekkol meleket shabbat vehilkoteha anu lemedin mimmishkan, vachatzar hammishkan gam ken lo haya muqqap ledira vehayu metaltelin bekullo, lepikak lo ratzu chakamim leesor ad shiur zeh vead biklal. Abal yoter mishshiur zeh apillu mashshehu — asur letaltel bo ella bed' ammot, veken lehotzi mechatzer letoko umittoko lechatzer:

Vaapillu bepachot mishshiur zeh, eno muttar letaltel mittoko lechatzer o mechatzer letoko ella kelim sheshshabetu betoko o bechatzer. Abal kelim sheshshabetu babbayit vehotziam lechatzer, asur letaltel letoko. Veken kelim sheshshabetu betoko vehiknisan lechatzer, asur letaltelan labbayit (vaapillu kelim sheshshabetu bechatzer vehiknisam labbayit o letoko — asur letaltelam mizzeh lazeh ella im ken yannichem bechatzer benetayim), lepi shemmaqom zeh shello huqqap ledira hu reshut bipne atzmah, muchleqet mehabbayit shehu meqom dira mammash. Abal im hechatzer hu reshut achat, ap al pi shehechatzer niqret "muqqap ledira". Vaapillu hechatzer hu shel adam echad, vehaqqarpep vekayyotze bo mimmeqomot shello huqqepu ledira hu shel acher, velo erebu yachad — muttar letaltel mizzeh lezeh kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sha"b. Abal letaltel mehabbayit leqarpep vekayyotze bo, o mimmennu labbayit — en erub moil. Vaapillu hem shel adam echad, asur middibre soperim, mippene shehu kemotzi mereshut lirshut, chutz min harechaba sheachore habbattim, shehu reshut achat im habbattim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shn"t:

Kol maqom shehuqqap ledira, dehaynu liknisa vitzia tamid, kegon dir vesahar vechatzer, apillu yesh bo kamma milin — muttar letaltel bekullo umittoko lebayit umibbayit letoko. Veken gag habbayit shehu reshut hayyachid, al derek shennitbaer besimman shm"h, muttar letaltel bekullo apillu yesh bo yoter mibbet satayim, umiggag labbayit shettachtayv o lehepek. Umuttar letaltel mehaggag leqarpep vekayyotze bo, kemo mehechatzer vekayyotze bah leqarpep:

Vaapillu qarpep vekayyotze bo, im hiqqipu mechitztzotayv ledira — dino kechatzer lekol dabar, ben lehattir hattiltul betoko yoter mid' ammot, apillu hu yoter mibbet satayim, uben mittoko labbayit umibbayit letoko. Umahu "huqqap ledira" zo sheasa bo techilla? Sukkat shomerim sheddar bah hashshomer bayyom uballayla, o shebbana bo techilla bet dira — ap al pi sheeno dar bah biqbiut — veachar kak hiqqipo mechitztzot, o apillu patach techilla petach bilbad mibbeto (o shehaya happetach patuach mikkebar) veachar kak hiqqip od g' mechitztzot samuk lekotel habbayit shebbo happetach — hare zeh muqqap ledira, shekkevan shehu patuach lebet dira, chashub kebet dira kemo chatzar habbayit. Raq shetztzarik shebbishat asiyyat mechitztzotayv tehe asiyyatan ledira:

Lepikak im hiqqipo mechitztzot veachar kak bana bo dira, o sheppatach lo achar kak petach mibbeto — lo hoil kelum. Vaapillu im bishat asiyyat hammechitztzot haya bedato sheoseh leshem kak libnot bo veliptoach lo achar kak, en zeh moil kelum. Umikkol maqom en tzarik shekkol mechitztzotayv tehe asiyyatan ledira, ella apillu hiqqipo g' mechitztzot shelemot, raq shebbarebiit haya parutz yoter meeser ammot, sheppirtza zo mebattelet hammechitztzot, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"b, veqodem sheggadar hayyater meeser asa bo sukka o bet dira o petach mibbet dira — hare zeh muqqap ledira. Veim bana dira etzel pirtza zo, vegoder hayyater al eser, umanniach haeser shehen petach middira zo — hare zeh gam ken muqqap ledira. Veken im haya muqqap kebar kullo shello ledira, poretz bo yoter meeser vegodero ledira, o yigdor hayyater al eser bilbad, vehaeser ammot hen petach:

Veim poretz amma ugedarah ledira, vechazar uparatz amma ugedarah, vechazar veasa ken ad shehishlimo leyater meeser — muttar keillu paratz bebat achat, mippene sheppanim chadashot bau lekan, kemo beporetz bebat achat vegoder achar kak. Veim paratz yoter meeser, veasa sham tzurat happetach ledira — moil kemo haggoder ledira:

Veim qasheh alayv liprotz hakkotel, yesh omerim sheyyesh taqqana, al yede sheyyanniach apar etzel hakkotel mishshene tzedadayv begobah pachot mi' tepachim, verochab heapar d' tepachim o yoter beorek yoter meeser ammot beorek hakkotel, veim en hakkotel gaboah k' tepachim, shennimtza en y' tepachim begobah hakkotel shemmiggobah heapar ulemala — hare hu nechshab keparutz sham bimqom heapar, shehare yesh sham derisat haregel miqqarqa olam al gabbe heapar, hoil veen begobho y' tepachim, vekol pachot mi' tepachim hu keparutz upatuach legamre; umin heapar yesh derisat haregel al gabbe hakkotel, sheshsham eno gaboah asara, vahare hu keparutz sham legamre; vihe heapar munnach kak lepachot shabbat achat, veqodem sheyyachazor vipannehu mishsham yaaseh betoko bet dira o yiptach lo petach mibbet dira, veachar kak keshemmepannehu mishsham venaaseh hakkotel gaboah asara, hare zeh kebonehu mechadash ledira. Veap al pi shezzo hi mechitztza hannaaset meeleha al yede pinnuy heapar shechutza lah, en bekak kelum, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"b. Veyesh choleqin al zeh, veomerim shezzeh shebbittel heapar lihyot munnach sham shabbat achat, en zeh moil kelum lebattel hakkotel sheyyehe nechshab keparutz, hoil vedato lachazor ulepannoto mikkan leachar zeman. Veen heapar yakol lebattel hakkotel ella im ken bittelo sham lihyot munnach sham leolam, veim ken bammeh yigderennu ledira? Lepikak en heapar moil ella im ken yesh begobho y' tepachim, vehirchiqo min hakkotel g' tepachim, sheaz hu naaseh mechitztza chadasha umebattel mechitztza harishona sheetzlo beorek yoter mi' ammot, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veaz en tzarik lihyot berochbo d' tepachim, vegam en tzarik lehannicho mib' tzedade hakkotel, ella mitztziddo shebbipnim bilbad, abal betzad hachutz en moil kelum. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:

Yesh omerim shessetam qarpepiyyot shellanu muqqapin ledira hem, ki regilin liptoach petach techilla veachar kak lehaqqip. Veyesh omerim od shekkol qarpep shehu betok hattechum niqra muqqap ledira, ki dato alayv beshabbat. Veen zeh iqqar, kemo shennitbaer lemala barechaba sheachore habbattim, shekkeshehi yetera mibbet satayim karmelit hi, ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman shn"t:

Tel gaboah y' tepachim dino keqarpep, shead satayim muttar letaltel bekullo, mishshum sheomerim gud asseq mechitztzato lemala y' tepachim, vahare hu muqqap. Veyoter mibbet satayim en metaltelin bo ella bed' ammot, shehare lo huqqap ledira:

Qarpep yoter mibbet satayim shennata bo ilanot lemaet aviro — en zeh miut, shekken derek haqqarpepot lihyot bahem ilanot. Lepikak apillu hayu hailanot gebohim asara urechabim d', shecholeqin reshut leatzman, en memaatin. Veken habborot shebbeginnot, apillu amuqqim asara urechabim d' — tashmish hagginna hem lehashqotah, veen memaatin. Abal dabar acher sheeno tzorek hagginna (veen darko lihyot betokah) — memaetet:
Bana ammud beqarpep venitmaet bekak, im hu rachab g' tepachim — hare zeh miut. Pachot mikken — batel bemiuto:

Bana mechitztza beorek yoter meeser lipne mechitztza harishona lebattelah, shettihyeh kemo sheenah, veyihyeh muqqap ledira al yede mechitztza zo, kegon sheasa bo bet dira o patach bo petach mibbet dira qodem sheasa mechitztza zo, im hirchiqah meharishona g' tepachim — muttar, veim lav — lo asa velo kelum, shekkol pachot mig' tepachim kelabud dami, veeno ella mosip al obi harishona, veen zeh moil ella im ken nitmaet aviro mibbet satayim, kemo sheyyitbaer leqamman:
Tach tit al mechitztzot harishonot lemaet aviro venitmaet mibbet satayim, im hattit ab sheim tinnatel hammechitztza rauy hu laamod bipne atzmo — memaet, veim lav — eno memaet:

Bana mechitztzot ledira al gabbe mechitztzot harishonot milmala, eno moil kelum, kevan shemmechitztzot harishonot millematta qayyamot, ella shemmagbihan. Veim nibleu hattachtonot venisharu haelyonot — nittar al yadan, ap al pi shemmechitztza haasuya meeleha hi. Abal tel yoter mibbet satayim sheasa alayv mechitztzot ledira, hoil apillu lo hirchiqan g' tepachim missepato, vesham anu omerim gud asseq mimmechitztzotayv lemala al sepato sabib, vahare mechitztzot al gabbe mechitztzot — mikkol maqom hoil vehu dar baavir mechitztzot ellu shellemala sheasaan atta ledira, hare zeh muqqap ledira, vaapillu lo asa ella mechitztza achat beyoter measara:

Qarpep yoter mibbet satayim shehuqqap ledira, venata rubbo ilanot, apillu enam asuyot shurot shurot — enam mebattelim haddira, shedderek hu lehistopep betzel hailanot tamid. Abal im nizra rubbo — hazzeraim mebattelim haddira apillu en bahem bet satayim, lepi sheen derek ladur bizraim, vehammiut shello nizra batel legabbe rob hannizra, veneesar kullo keillu lo huqqap kelal ledira. Nizra miuto, im en bezarua ella bet satayim — muttar letaltel bekullo, sheap shebbemaqom hazzarua nitbattela haddira, hare en bo yoter mibbet satayim, vehashshear shello nizra eno mitbattel etzel hazzarua lehitztarep immo lehashlim leyoter mibbet satayim, kevan shehazzarua hu hammuat. Abal asur letaltel miqqarpep zeh labbayit umibbayit letoko, shehare bemaqom hazzarua shebbo nitbattela haddira, vedino keqarpep shello huqqap ledira sheen metaltelin mimmennu labbayit, kemo shennitbaer lemala; veim ken gam behammotar shello nizra asur, shehare en mechitztza mapseqet benehem vehem perutzim zeh lezeh bemilluam. Veyesh mattirin behammotar shello nizra, shello ameru "pirtza bemilluah oseret" ella keshennipretza lemaqom haasur mitztzad atzmo, kegon karmelit gemura, abal kan, shemmaqom hazzarua haasur en issuro ella mechamat habbayit, eno oser al hashshear shello nizra, ap al pi shehu parutz lo bemilluo. Veyesh lehachamir kisbara harishona. Abal im miut hannizra hu pachot mibbet satayim — muttar letaltel ap mittoko labbayit umibbayit letoko. Veap al pi shekkol qarpep bet satayim upachot mibbet satayim shavim hem, sheim lo huqqepu ledira en metaltelim mehem labbayit, mikkol maqom kan, sheharob eno zarua umuqqap ledira hu, hare hammiut batel etzlo, ella im ken yesh bo satayim kachatzar hammishkan, sheaz hu maqom chashub velo batel. Veyesh oserim letaltel labbayit mimmaqom hazzarua, umattirim mimmaqom sheeno zarua. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel. Veim hammiut hazzarua hu yoter mibbet satayim — asur letaltel bekol haqqarpep ki im bed' ammot, shehare hazzarua hu karmelit kedin qarpep yoter mibbet satayim shello huqqap ledira, vehashshear shello nizra hu parutz lo bemilluo. Vekol zeh beqarpep yoter mibbet satayim shennizra. Abal im en bo ella bet satayim venizra apillu kullo, yesh lehistappeq im hazzeraim mebattelim haddira. Veken yesh lehistappeq bechatzer o rechaba sheachore habbattim shennizra rubbah — im hazzeraim mebattelim diratan, ki shemma enam mebattelim ella dirat qarpep yoter mibbet satayim, sheeno chashub dira kol kak ap al pi shehiqqipo ledira. Veyesh lehachamir bekol zeh. Lepikak mi sheyyesh lo ginna zarua bachatzero veen benehen mechitztza kehilkatah, im hazzarua hu rob hechatzer, apillu en bet satayim bekol hechatzer im hazzarua — lo yetaltel mehazzarua umehechatzer labbayit umibbayit lahem, ki shemma hazzeraim mebattelim dirat hechatzer vehammiut batel legabbe harob, vahare kol hechatzer keqarpep shello huqqap ledira, sheapillu hu pachot mibbet satayim en metaltelin mimmennu labbayit. Veim kol hechatzer im hazzarua hu yoter mibbet satayim — en metaltelin bekol hechatzer ki im bed' ammot, kedin qarpep yoter mibbet satayim shello huqqap ledira. Veap shehechatzer hi muqqepet ledira, mitztarepet hi im hazzarua shebbah lehashlimo leyoter mibbet satayim, hoil vehi betela etzlo bemiutah. Veim hazzarua hu miut hechatzer, im yesh bo lebaddo yoter mibbet satayim — oser kol hechatzer shello letaltel bah ella bed' ammot, hoil vehi nipretza lo bemilluah. Veim yesh bo bet satayim bilbad — yesh lehachamir shello letaltel mikkol hechatzer labbayit. Veim en bo bet satayim — yesh lehaqel apillu letaltel mehazzarua labbayit o lehepek:

Abal im yesh benehem mechitztza kehilkatah, en hazzarua oser al hechatzer kelal, ella, im hazzarua hu yoter mibbet satayim — asur letaltel mechatzer letoko apillu betok d' ammot. Veim hu bet satayim o pachot — muttar bekelim sheshshabetu bo o bechatzer, abal lo bekelim sheshshabetu babbayit. Al ken rauy shello leekol o lishtot beginna beshabbat, ki i epshar lizzaher bezeh, veheqqep ledira eno moil beginna, shehazzeraim mebattelim haddira kemo shennitbaer:

Qarpep yoter mibbet satayim shehuqqap ledira veniknesu bo mayim, im reuyim lishtiyya — en mebattelim haddira, sheen leka dira meulla mizzo. Vaapillu im hammaqom shennitpashshetu sham hu yoter mibbet satayim, apillu hem amuqqim harbeh. Veim enam reuyim lishtiyya — dinam kizraim, vehu sheyyesh beomqam y' tepachim. Abal im en beomqam asara tepachim hare hem ketit ureqaq, sheen choleqin reshut leatzmam. Ukesheyyesh beomqam y' tepachim, im mitlaqqet y' tepachim betok hilluk d' ammot — hem atzmam nechshab limchitztza benam lishar haqqarpep, kemo shennitbaer besimman sham"[h] vesimman shn"v, veen shear haqqarpep neesar mechamat shepparutz lo bemilluo:

Qarpep bet g' sein shello huqqap ledira, veqera bet sea — muttar letaltel bekullo (sheanu roin et pi hattiqra keillu hi mechitztza yoredet vesotemet umapseqet ben hab' bet sein lashshelishit). Vaapillu im haqqeruy hu meshuppa (sheen omerim bo "pi tiqra yored vesotem" kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh[s]"a, kan heqellu), mikkol maqom roin keillu hayeta mechitztza gemura besop haqqeruy:

Qarpep bet satayim metzumtzamim shello huqqap ledira shennipratz bemilluo lechatzer haqqarpep, asur, mippene shemmeqom hammechitztza shennipretza meyattero, venaasa yoter al bet satayim. Vehechatzer mutteret im pirtza zo enah lah bemilluah veenah yoter mi' ammot (ukegon shehaqqarpep hu qatzar kan ulehalea hu mitracheb veholek, sheim lo ken hare yehe orko yater al pi shenayim berochbo, veen metaltelin bo ella bed' ammot apillu lo nipretza kelal). Abal im lo nipratz bemilluo ella nisharu bo gippupin mikkan umikkan, en meqom happirtza meyattero, lepi shechuddan happenimi shel haggippupin yored vesotem, umechuddan happenimit velachutz hu reshut bipne atzmo, shemmittaam zeh asur letaltel mibbayit laisquppa im en aleha mashqop rachab d', kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v. (Vaapillu nipratz bemilluo — eno asur ella im ken kotle orko boletim veniknasim letok chalal hechatzer, vehem muplagim sham g' tepachim mikkotle orek hechatzer, sheim lo ken nittar hu begippupe hechatzer, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"s):

Qarpep yoter mibbet satayim shello huqqap ledira, veachar kak patach bo petach mibbet dira — sheppetach zeh eno moil kelum — veachar kak asa mechitztza sheniyya yoter meeser, vehuttar al yede mechitztza zo shennaaset achar petichat happetach, sheal yadeha botla hammechitztza harishona shello hayeta asiyyatah ledira, veachar kak nopla mechitztza zo hashsheniyya — chazar leissuro, veen omerim bo "hoil vehuttar — huttar", vetoil lo akshav mechitztza harishona:
